name: oktz-signal
description: Signal protocol Rust native — MIT replacement for libsignal (GPL)

scripts.build:native: napi build --release --platform --js-package-name @oktz-signal/signal --config-path napi.config.json --manifest-path native/signal/Cargo.toml --output-dir native/signal --js index.cjs.generated
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:loader
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run verify:loader
